form.title: OCIA Inquiry
form.successTitle: Thank you. We have your information.
form.successBody: Someone from the OCIA team will be in touch about the next session. Watch for a copy of this form in your email.
step.getting-started.title: Getting started
step.getting-started.help: This takes about fifteen minutes. Nothing here commits you to anything. We save your progress as you go, so you can close this and come back.
step.getting-started.welcome.html: The Order of Christian Initiation for Adults is how adults come into the Catholic Church, and it is also where people go simply to ask questions. Some of what follows is personal. Answer what you can, and leave anything blank that you would rather talk about in person.
step.getting-started.parish.label: Which parish are you coming to?
step.getting-started.privacyNotice.html: This information is used for the purposes of the Church Office only and will not be given out without consent.

step.civil-status.help: The Church asks about marriage because it affects which sacraments are open to you. If any of this is difficult, leave it blank and tell us in person instead.
